title: Brawl Stars x Duolingo Event Is Live With New Rewards
summary: The Brawl Stars x Duolingo event has begun, bringing Duo to Starr Park, community challenges, a new Duo Boss Fight, and multiple free rewards.
content:
Brawl Stars has teamed up with Duolingo for a new limited-time event that brings Duo into Starr Park.

The event is split into two phases. In the first phase, players take part in community gameplay goals and work together to unlock rewards. The second phase introduces a detention-themed challenge with additional tasks for the community.

The event also introduces the Duo Boss Fight. Players must cooperate with teammates, answer Duo's questions, and survive the fight as the boss becomes increasingly aggressive.

Rewards include the Trash Goblin Darryl Skin, Chaos Drops, Gems, Starr Drops, Coins, Power Points, Bling, Credits, and other progression rewards.

The official event runs through September 30, 2026, while the related Duolingo quest provides additional rewards and cosmetics.

faq.question: When does the Brawl Stars x Duolingo event run?
faq.answer: The main event runs until September 30, 2026.

faq.question: What is the Duo Boss Fight?
faq.answer: It is a cooperative game mode where players answer Duo's questions while working together against him.

faq.question: What rewards are available?
faq.answer: Rewards include the Trash Goblin Darryl Skin, Chaos Drops, Gems, Starr Drops, Coins, Power Points, Bling, Credits, and more.

faq.question: Is there a Duolingo quest?
faq.answer: Yes. Players can open the Duolingo app and complete the Brawl Stars Quest for additional rewards and cosmetics.
